title: algolia search can be done in single component ..?
body:
algolia search can be done in one component.  ? 
how to pass the query  in other components

comments.body: Hi @nyazkhan thanks for taking the time to contribute. Can you add more details to your request? I don't get what you're trying to do.

@bobylito  sir I'm trying to connect algolia search with angular 2 project in a single component 
but in the documentation 
(https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/angular-integration.html#refining-even-further)
there are 3 component hitComponent, searchComponent, and refineComponent
it can be possible to convert these three components into a single component..?

> it can be possible to convert these three components into a single component..?

Not really. Why would you need to merge the three components? @nyazkhan

I'm closing this issue for now. Feel free to open a new one, [discuss the topic](https://discourse.algolia.com/) on our community forum or [post your question](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/algolia) on stack overflow
